svg.title: Maine Coon measurement landmarks on a real photograph
svg.desc: A real Maine Coon with nose tip, shoulder area, tail base and tail tip labelled. This walking pose identifies landmarks only. Measure a relaxed standing cat with its tail naturally extended for total length.

g.text: Where to measure your Maine Coon
Real photograph. Landmarks only, not a measured size or ideal measuring pose.
Body length: nose tip to tail base
Total length: nose tip to tail tip, with tail naturally extended
Shoulder height: level floor to top of shoulder blades
Measure a relaxed, still-standing cat. Do not pull its tail or measure from this photo.
Photo: Hollakr / Kayla Roth, Wikimedia Commons, public domain.
Measurement labels added by Wise Maine Coon. Shoulder and tail-base landmarks are approximate under fur.
